metadata.question: Was the land surface temperature in New Mexico in July 2016 higher than in any other July over the past 30 years?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: MODIS LST day (1 km) or Landsat 8/9 LST (30 m). MODIS is more stable and has 30-year coverage. - Date: All Juli between 1992 and 2022 (2 extra for safety) with month = 7. - Location: New Mexico state boundary does not need to be exact; we’ll use a representative polygon of ~10,000 km² to keep counts reasonable. 2. Masking strategy: - All-weather – none for LST since clouds already have 0 flag (QA 0/1) and we need full coverage. 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - For each July year extract mean LST. If collection for any July has 0 images → C1. If any pixel count after masking is zero after 100 km² AOI test → C2. If any mean is NaN → C3. - Then simply find max of 30 years and compare 2016 value. ```python import ee, datetime ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry nm = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-109.05, 31.33, -103, 37]) # ~NM extent, ~1e4 km² # 2. Acquire MODIS LST Day 1 km (all July 1992-2022) col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD11A2').select('LST_Day_1km') # 8-day, in K def july_mean(y): j = (ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD11A2') .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(y, y, 'year')) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(7, 7, 'month')) .select('LST_Day_1km')) c = j.size().getInfo() if c == 0: return None img = j.mean().multiply(0.02) # scale to K cnt = img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=nm, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo() if cnt == 0: return None val = img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=nm, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo() return val - 273.15 # K to °C # 3. Build 30-year list years = range(1992, 2023) lst = {} for y in years: v = july_mean(y) if v is None: print(f"{y} Images: 0 -> C1 best avoided but continue") continue lst[y] = v print(f"{y}: {v:.2f} °C") # 4. Check data if 2016 not in lst: print("C1") else: max_y = max(lst, key=lst.get) print(f"Max {max_y} {lst[max_y]:.2f} | 2016 {lst[2016]:.2f}") if lst[2016] >= lst[max_y]: print("A") else: print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee, datetime
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry
nm = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-109.05, 31.33, -103, 37])  # ~NM extent, ~1e4 km²

# 2. Acquire MODIS LST Day 1 km (all July 1992-2022)
col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD11A2').select('LST_Day_1km')   # 8-day, in K
def july_mean(y):
    j = (ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD11A2')
            .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(y, y, 'year'))
            .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(7, 7, 'month'))
            .select('LST_Day_1km'))
    c = j.size().getInfo()
    if c == 0: return None
    img = j.mean().multiply(0.02)  # scale to K
    cnt = img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=nm, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo()
    if cnt == 0: return None
    val = img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=nm, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo()
    return val - 273.15  # K to °C

# 3. Build 30-year list
years = range(1992, 2023)
lst = {}
for y in years:
    v = july_mean(y)
    if v is None:
        print(f"{y} Images: 0  -> C1 best avoided but continue")
        continue
    lst[y] = v
    print(f"{y}: {v:.2f} °C")

# 4. Check data
if 2016 not in lst: print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    max_y = max(lst, key=lst.get)
    print(f"Max {max_y} {lst[max_y]:.2f} | 2016 {lst[2016]:.2f}")
    if lst[2016] >= lst[max_y]:
        print("<answer>A</answer>")
    else:
        print("<answer>B</answer>")
